newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Crown halted Swedish Riksbank December repo cut.
newsitem.headline: Crown halted Swedish Riksbank December repo cut.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, considered cutting its key repurchase rate further in December but has not been able to do so because of a softer crown.
"In December there were some thoughts about some room to further lower the rate," Riksbank deputy governor Lars Heikensten told a monetary policy seminar. "But since then the crown has softened."
The Riksbank lowered the repo to its current level of 4.10 percent from 8.91 percent last year. The crown has effectively softened 6-7 percent since October last year, Heikensten said at the seminar.
He told the seminar that monetary policy was well balanced and that further repo rate cuts were not likely to strengthen the crown.
"I think the traditional effect of rate cuts (a softer currency) has been the dominating effect, at least during the past six months," he told the seminar
